summary: The data partition: made by a new install and by rach2-install --data, kept across an update, and the trial roots bootctl rootimage boots from it; the scenario is tests/cases/machine/datapart_scenario.c

cases.behavior: a new install with a root of 96 MiB makes the data partition after it, and a file on it is kept across an update of the root with its entry unchanged; a broken root image armed with bootctl rootimage is refused and the boot after it takes the installed root, a good one boots once from the data partition with the partition at /data, and a disk installed whole gains the data partition from rach2-install --data, run twice, and boots
units: `utils/rach2-install`'s data partition, its root size question and `--data`

inputs.root: installer-root.ext2 on the stick, the update's root and the trial root
inputs.target: an empty disk of 256 MiB filled with the pattern of fill_pattern

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends each machine and removes the copies, which it keeps after a failure; the scenario removes its own directory unless an assertion failed

steps.does: fill both disks with the pattern and read the demo password
boot the stick beside the disk, install with a root of 96 MiB, write a file and the two trial roots to the data partition, update the root from the stick and read the file back
boot the disk, commit the updated root and arm the broken trial root
boot the disk and see the kernel refuse the broken image and restart
boot the disk and log in to the installed root
boot the disk and arm the good trial root
boot the disk into the trial root and read its line, its mounts and bootctl's status
boot the disk and log in to the installed root again
boot the stick beside the spare disk, install with the root grown whole, and run rach2-install --data twice
boot the spare disk and write a file on its data partition

assertions.checks: both disks are filled with the pattern, and the demo password is read
the install makes entry 6 and its file system and grows the root up to it, and a file written there reads back after rach2-install --update, on a data partition that checks clean
the data partition's line in /proc/disk names Rach2 data and is the same before and after the update
the updated root commits, and bootctl rootimage arms the broken image
the next boot mounts the broken image's partition, finds no file system in the image, says it restarts into the saved default and stops
the boot after it starts the installed root from the candidate's line
bootctl rootimage arms the good image

the next boot logs in to the image's root with the image's password, its line has rach2.slot=trialroot, a loop device is its root and the data partition is at /data, and bootctl says it booted trialroot
the boot after it starts the installed root from the candidate's line again

a disk installed with the root grown whole has no entry 6; rach2-install --data shrinks the root to 96 MiB and makes the data partition and its file system, a second run finds each step done, and both file systems check clean
the disk boots its shrunk root, and its data partition mounts and takes a file

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case installs onto disks from the install stick and boots trial roots from their data partitions
